title: Bodevia
description: Smart logistics optimization platform featuring real-time interactive 3D warehouse simulation. Enables teams to model smart inventory items, calculate dimensional metrics, weight thresholds, and turnover velocity to dynamically orchestrate warehouse layouts and compute optimal picking paths.
impact: Transforms traditional warehousing into an intuitive, scalable visual system designed for zero loss, algorithmic route optimization, and seamless adaptation across diverse retail, tech, and industrial supply chains.

title: Unsaid
description: Independent personal editorial publication ('Lo que no dije') engineered with Astro SSG and a Zero-JS by default architecture achieving a 100/100 Google Lighthouse score. Features Astro ClientRouter (View Transitions API) for fluid SPA navigation with persisted sidebar state (transition:persist), Astro Content Collections with compile-time Zod schema validation, interactive MDX essays, automated RSS syndication (/rss.xml), and an editorial 'Paper Tone' palette styled with Tailwind CSS v4 & @tailwindcss/typography.
impact: Combines classic print aesthetics with modern web performance: zero unnecessary client-side JavaScript, compile-time strict type safety, and instant page transitions between essays.

title: SignandGo
description: Comprehensive digital signature and document control platform built with Django and PostgreSQL on the backend, responsive styling with Bootstrap 5, and agile client reactivity using HTMX and Alpine.js—eliminating the bloat of heavy SPA frameworks while providing high-fidelity canvas signature capture.
impact: Enables seamless in-browser canvas signatures, cutting turnaround times while guaranteeing legal validity, cryptographic integrity, and full audit logs for all parties.

title: The Crawler
description: Automation suite featuring a Chrome extension (Manifest V3) paired with a web orchestration platform. Leverages Playwright and AI/LLMs to automate browser navigation, scraping workflows, and complex repetitive web actions.
impact: Eliminates countless hours of tedious manual browsing workflows, allowing teams to launch headless automation and data extraction with a single click.

title: Karla Smile
description: Cross-platform mobile application built in Flutter with a Django backend for event logistics and 360° rotating video booths. Features dynamic video capture, music overlays, custom visual filters, and framed branding assets.
impact: Processes and distributes personalized video clips to event attendees in real time via high-throughput cloud delivery pipelines.

title: check.lo justo
description: Official open-access metrology platform for physicochemical measurement verification and normative matrix exports. Powered by a high-throughput FastAPI backend implementing certified mathematical models, notably the Benson & Krause equations for high-precision dissolved oxygen solubility calculations compensated for temperature, atmospheric pressure, and salinity.
impact: Enables laboratories, field engineers, and industrial compliance teams to instantly validate and calibrate sensors (Dissolved Oxygen, pH, Electrical Conductivity) with certified metrological precision and zero friction.

title: The Wasppers
description: Custom enterprise-grade messaging center modeled after WhatsApp Web with native Dark and Light mode support, multi-line concurrent routing, autonomous AI agent integration, and smart bots.
impact: Engineered custom for high-volume customer support and sales logistics. Integrates low-latency WebSockets, automated human vs. bot triage (JustoBot), and dynamic lead routing.

title: Vicuña Rise
description: Action-platformer video game crafted with Godot Engine, featuring a rich Andean pixel art aesthetic, custom dynamic 2D/3D physics mechanics, and optimized visual shaders.
impact: In final development and performance optimization stage ahead of its upcoming official launch on the App Store and Google Play Store.
metrics: Coming soon to App Store & Play Store
